summary: Iteration 5 re-test: BOTH iter4 critical bugs are FIXED and verified end-to-end. (1) POST /api/trades/apply now resolves custom strategies via find_strategy() and returns 200 — confirmed via pytest (test_apply_custom_trade) and live UI (Place Paper Trade on custom strategy → portfolio shows open_count:1, unrealized_pnl:-204.25). (2) app/(tabs)/chain.tsx now opens WebSocket to /api/ws/chain/{symbol} and renders a LIVE badge (testID='chain-live-badge') — verified visible with text 'LIVE' on Chain tab, stays LIVE when switching NIFTY → BANKNIFTY. Backend tests: 22/23 pass (only failure is the security-tightening assertion from prev agent: greeks lookup with no username currently returns 200, recommend tightening but not blocker). All 5 built-in strategies (iron_condor, short_strangle, bull_put_spread, covered_call, long_straddle) apply 200 OK. WebSocket chain stream and invalid-symbol close still work. Editor → Preview Payoff → Save persists to backend; custom strategy appears on Strategies tab with CUSTOM badge; detail modal renders Payoff chart + Net Greeks (Δ/Γ/Θ/V) + Structure + Lots selector + Place Paper Trade button.

minor.issue: find_strategy() still does NOT require username when strategy_id starts with 'custom_'. Any user who knows a custom_xxxxxxxxxx id can fetch greeks/payoff for another user's strategy (minor info leak). Same as iter4 minor note — recommend adding `if not username: return None` when id startswith 'custom_'.

integration_issues.flow: Editor → Save → return to Strategies tab
integration_issues.issue: On react-native-web, Alert.alert('Saved',...,[{text:'OK', onPress: () => router.replace('/(tabs)/strategies')}]) — the onPress callback does NOT fire after the user dismisses the web alert, so the user remains on the Editor screen after a successful save (backend persists fine). Works on real Expo Go / native. Either (a) replace Alert.alert with a custom in-app modal whose Confirm button calls router.replace, or (b) call router.replace BEFORE Alert.alert. Backend save is unaffected.

integration_issues.flow: Strategies tab refresh after returning from editor
integration_issues.issue: app/(tabs)/strategies.tsx uses `useEffect(()=>{...}, [u])` to fetch built-in + custom strategies. When navigating back from /editor the screen does not remount, so newly saved customs only appear after a manual reload of the tab (e.g., logout/login or pull-to-refresh). Use `useFocusEffect` from '@react-navigation/native' or 'expo-router' to refetch on focus.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Tighten find_strategy() in server.py: when strategy_id starts with 'custom_' require username, return None otherwise. Closes minor cross-user info leak on /api/greeks and /api/payoff.

(Recommended) In app/editor.tsx, replace `Alert.alert('Saved', ..., [{text:'OK', onPress:()=>router.replace('/(tabs)/strategies')}])` with either: navigate first then alert, or use a custom modal. Current code leaves the user on the Editor screen on web preview after a successful save.

(Recommended) Change strategies.tsx useEffect → useFocusEffect so the strategies list refreshes when returning from /editor. Without this fix, even after the Alert.alert issue is fixed, a freshly-saved custom strategy will not appear until the tab is unmounted/remounted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still ~1740 lines — split into routers (auth, market, strategies, ws, payments, trades, broker, notifications) — same comment as iter4.
find_strategy() username-optional behavior is a latent security issue — easy fix, do it now.
Editor uses Alert.alert with onPress callback — known react-native-web limitation; this pattern recurs and should be avoided.
strategies.tsx should use useFocusEffect — useEffect only fires on first mount of the tab, not on re-focus.

success_rate.backend: 96% (22/23) — only failing test is the security-tightening assertion (no-username greeks lookup) which is a recommendation, not an iter4 acceptance criterion
success_rate.frontend: 100% on iter4 acceptance criteria — LIVE badge visible, symbol switch works, custom strategy apply succeeds end-to-end (verified via portfolio open_count=1)
